text:
ellie_sales: Heads-up — Aurelia Systems wants ISO/SSAE excerpts + a signed external-scan attestation for their EU staging POC. They want all docs by Wed 4pm CET. Also asked for a Dedicated EU cost estimate for low-latency test runs.
tom_se: Got it. Do we have an ISO excerpt that we can share for POCs (redacted)? Any objections to sending that + a short controls summary? @emma_security
emma_security: We keep an "ISO_summary_redacted.pdf" that works for presales. I can add a one-paragraph controls scope note. For the external-scan attestation I can sign our standard template; legal should review if they request alternative sig wording.
ellie_sales: They specifically asked that logs and KMS stay in eu-central-1. Can Dedicated cover that without Private?
marta_ops: Yes — Dedicated with customer-managed KMS in eu-central-1 satisfies EU residency for logs and key material. Timeline: KMS provisioning + IAM bindings ~48 hours, routing + log retention config ~same day after that.
tom_se: Pricing? Give me a quick line to add to the quote.
marta_ops: ballpark: `dedicated-small: €7,250/mo`, `kms-key: €200/mo`, `one-time-setup: €2,000`. If they agree to a 3-month commit, we can waive half of the setup fee.
ellie_sales: Aurelia also asked whether an external scan (Qualys-type) is sufficient for procurement signoff instead of full internal pen-test. Any red flags?
emma_security: For a POC external vulnerability scan + signed attestation is acceptable 99% of the time. For enterprise legal we usually require a penetration test before production cutover. I'll note that in the attestation: "External scan acceptable for POC; full engagement may be requested for production."
tom_se: Great. Can you upload the docs and generate presigned links? Also need the pen-test letter with a blank signature block for Anya at Aurelia.
emma_security: Uploaded two items to secure drive. Links below expire in 5 days. `ISO_excerpt`: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/ISO_excerpt_redacted_Aurelia.pdf
`external-scan-attestation`: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/external_scan_attestation_Aurelia.docx
legal-bot: file uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/external_scan_attestation_Aurelia.docx (expires in 5 days)
ellie_sales: Perfect. I'll send to Anya (anya@aurelia-sys.com). Quick check: do we need a signed NDA before handing over network diagrams? They didn't ask for diagrams but procurement sometimes requests them.
emma_security: We don't send internal network diagrams without an NDA. If they ask, route to legal@redwood.com and we'll gate via presigned S3 + NDA acceptance.
marta_ops: Minor ops note: if they want 90-day log retention in eu-central, that fits within our retention policy on Dedicated. If they pick Hosted EU (not yet offered), we can't guarantee single-region log residency.
tom_se: I'll add a line-item for "EU KMS + 90d logs" and mark setup lead time 2 business days.
ellie_sales: Aurelia asked about proof of vulnerability remediation SLA — procurement asked for a 10-business-day remediation window for critical findings identified in the scan. Can we commit?
emma_security: We avoid committing to customer remediation SLAs for customer code. We can commit to responding to findings in our infra within 5 business days; for customer app issues we recommend a joint runbook. I'll add a clarifying note in the attestation.
ellie_sales: Ok will include that wording and send out. Thanks team — will update when I have confirmation from Anya. :white_check_mark:
